{{Top|leg}}
'''''Revt''''' was a group of three [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] they were present at a Rebel supply outpost consisting of 3 [[Class-A cargo container]]s ''[[Duce]]'' and were unmanned but were going to be docked by [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s under flight group ''[[T-SE]]'' to fight back, while the other flight group ''[[T-SF]]'' was to dock with the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] to ferry pilots to the fighters. Either way, they were destroyed by [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] along with the two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]] ''[[Bultz]]'' and the [[Container transport]] [[Moth (Container transport)|''Moth'']].

The battle was recorded and adapted into the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of which was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
